A little help. A lot of heart.

A clear next step for little helpers.

Child-friendly chore charts should be easy to read, easy to touch and encouraging to use.

01

Keep tasks achievable

Use short task names and responsibilities suitable for the child. Avoid using missed chores to judge personality or discipline.

02

Choose nicknames

A local child profile should not need a real name, birth date, email address or photo.

03

Celebrate effort

Positive feedback and a parent-defined reward can recognise a contribution without pressure or a countdown.
